findings.evidence: Lines 158, 186, 209, 217 each contain `(by fun_prop : Continuous fun … => …).measurable`.
findings.fix: Add two private lemmas, e.g. `private theorem continuous_ray (x v : E) : Continuous fun s : ℝ => x + s • v` and `private theorem measurable_rayProd : Measurable fun q : (E × E) × ℝ => q.1.1 + q.2 • q.1.2`, and use them at all four sites.
findings.issue: Continuity/measurability of the ray map is inlined as `(by fun_prop : Continuous …).measurable` four times: lines 158 and 186 for `fun s : ℝ => x + s • v`, and lines 209 and 217 for `fun q : (E × E) × ℝ => q.1.1 + q.2 • q.1.2`. These are reusable facts (§0.3's push-forward will need them) hidden inside proof bodies.

findings.fix: Factor a private lemma `setOf_mem_eq_preimage_inter : {s : ℝ | 0 ≤ s ∧ x + s • v ∈ S} = (fun s : ℝ => x + s • v) ⁻¹' S ∩ Ici 0` (plus a private `measurableSet_preimage_ray` from the lemma above) and rewrite with it in both `densityWeightedPathLength_indicator_const` and `densityWeightedPathLength_le`, replacing the hand-rolled `⟨hs.2, hs.1⟩` step.
findings.issue: The same preimage facts are re-proved in two theorems: `hpre` is a verbatim duplicate (157–158 vs 185–186); the identity `{s | 0 ≤ s ∧ x + s • v ∈ S} = (fun s => x + s • v) ⁻¹' S ∩ Ici 0` is proved at 159–161 and then re-derived ad hoc at 193–195 (`measure_mono fun s hs => ⟨hs.2, hs.1⟩`); and the `simp_rw [← Set.indicator_comp_right …, Function.comp_def]` rewrite is repeated at 164 and 189–190.

findings.evidence: Lines 123–125: `simp only [densityWeightedPathLength_def, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, integral_const_mul, mul_inv]` followed by the three-lemma `rw`.
findings.fix: Replace with robust automation, e.g. `field_simp` after the `simp only`, or at least anchor the arguments (`mul_comm c⁻¹ ρ₀⁻¹`).
findings.issue: `rw [mul_comm c⁻¹, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc]` is an unanchored three-step rewrite chain on the exact term shape `simp only` happens to leave; `mul_comm c⁻¹` rewrites whatever first match the simp set produces, so a change in `integral_const_mul`/`mul_inv` normalisation breaks it.

summary: Proofs are readable and free of defeq abuse, but the measurability/continuity facts about the ray map `s ↦ x + s • v` and the set identity relating `{s | 0 ≤ s ∧ x + s • v ∈ S}` to a preimage are open-coded repeatedly instead of being factored into private lemmas. One arithmetic step also relies on an unanchored rewrite chain.
